profile.headline: Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary: I am currently an Advisory Software Developer in IBM Systems and graduate from Virginia Tech. I currently work on the z/OS Container Platform. Previously I have worked in device allocation, the system management facilities (SMF), and scheduler for the BCP (kernel) of z/OS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I currently work in the z/OS Container Platform team implementing native container support. I was previously on the Job Management squad developing improvements to the device allocator, system management facility (SMF), and scheduler for z/OS.
positions.insights: C (Programming Language), Operating Systems and +5 skills

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Worked as a teaching assistant for an introductory C++ course, an intro course for data structures and algorithms, a course about computer organization, and an operating systems course in successive semesters.
positions.insights: C (Programming Language), Operating Systems and +1 skill

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked on a cache optimization improvement research project. Built testing harnesses to determine the viability of solutions and helped write the optimizations. Work was done by modifying the open source hardware emulator gem5. Development was done in Python, C++, and Bash scripting.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Hardware Simulation and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Developed a new reporting system in the System Management Facility (SMF) component of z/OS.
positions.insights: Operating Systems, Data Structures and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Testware developer working on a regression testing tool for z/OS mainframe development. Developed in several languages including Java, Javascript, and PHP.
